
```{r}
set.seed(123)
m <- NULL
for (i in 1:6) {
  m <- cbind(m, runif(20, 0, 10) |> as.integer())
}

colnames(m) <- paste0("q", 1:6)
rownames(m) <- paste0("sp", 1:20)

#===============

sample_col <- function(column, n) {
  replicate(n, sample(column, 20, replace = FALSE))
}

new_m <- do.call(cbind, lapply(1:6, function(i) sample_col(m[,i], 5)))

colnames(new_m) <- paste0(rep(paste0("q", 1:6), each = 5), "_", rep(1:5, 6))

new_m_sorted <- new_m[order(rownames(new_m)), ]
```
